description: The standing investment case for a stock: the thesis, its testable claims with the condition that breaks each, the bear case, catalysts, whether it still holds. Use when the user asks: what's the bull case for X; what would break X's thesis; is X's story holding up. response_mode=plain for beginners. Not for: valuation → answer. Args: entity; view.

entity.description: The company: a ticker (AAPL, BRK.B), a company name (Apple) or an SEC CIK.
entity.title: Entity

reading_level.description: With response_mode plain, who the explanation is written for: 5 a complete beginner, 10 a general reader, 13 an informed investor (unset reads as 13, with precise figures).
reading_level.title: Reading Level

response_mode.description: "standard" (default): the full read with the investment case; "plain": a short beginner-friendly explanation at the reading_level grade.
response_mode.title: Response Mode

view.description: "case" (default): the thesis, its testable claims, the bear case and catalysts; "review": the case re-checked against the latest filings; "story": whether the company's own narrative in its releases matches its reported numbers.
view.title: View

name: get_thesis
title: Investment thesis
